candidates.original_title: Beyond motivated reasoning: Hostile reactions to critical comments from the outgroup
candidates.description: Outgroup criticism elicits stronger defensive reactions than ingroup criticism, measured through costly behavioral responses (bonus withholding)
candidates.citation_sentence: we followed the procedures by Thürmer and McCrea (2018, Experiment 3) very closely
candidates.notes: The paper found a clear behavioral classic ISE (bonus decision) and self-report effects, all in the expected direction. Authors explicitly state 'Registered analyses revealed strong evidence for the classic ISE.' The paper also tests the bystander ISE (adapted from Sutton et al., 2006 and Adelman & Verkuyten, 2020) in the same experiment with the same participants; the behavioral bystander ISE was found contrary to the authors' social identity prediction, but the ISE was replicated overall.
